design_description: A clean, premium design that balances a minimalist white base with bold artistic brushstrokes concentrated around the lower body. Dynamic black and gold paint strokes rise from the hem in a symmetrical V-shaped composition, complemented by subtle gold paint splatter for added energy and refinement. The upper chest remains intentionally clean, giving the sponsor, crest, and logos maximum visibility while enhancing the elegant aesthetic. Navy-and-gold trim on the collar and sleeve cuffs ties the palette together, reinforcing the luxurious champagne-inspired color scheme. Overall, the jersey feels sophisticated, modern, and dynamic, combining understated elegance with expressive artistic detailing.
